changeSet.author: hwmdm
changeSet.comment: Plugin,new: moduleregistry — estado de manutencao dos modulos nativos do console, por customer
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_moduleregistry_state ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, customerId INTEGER NOT NULL, moduleId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, disabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, disabledBy VARCHAR(255), disabledAt TIMESTAMP, reason VARCHAR(500), CONSTRAINT plugin_moduleregistry_state_customer_module UNIQUE (customerId, moduleId) );

changeSet.author: hwmdm
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, description, superAdmin) VALUES ('modules_manage', 'Ligar e desligar modulos do console para manutencao', FALSE); INSERT INTO userRolePermissions (roleId, permissionId) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, (SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE name = 'modules_manage') FROM userroles r WHERE r.superAdmin OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM userRolePermissions urp JOIN permissions p ON p.id = urp.permissionId WHERE urp.roleId = r.id AND p.name = 'configurations');
